dedupe_keys.name: dataset for multi perspective traffic video analysis

description: Dataset for multi-perspective traffic video analysis is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ramon Sanchez-Iborra et al. Multi-angle video recordings are of significant interest as they provide synchronized data from multiple perspectives. This enables advanced analysis and modeling in environments with complex conditions due to their dynamics or the presence of obstacles, which lead to occlusions or loss of information in single-camera setups. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through the repository address listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
